operations.value:
Generalize origin-only sharing to named remotes. Add configuration and CLI selection for fetch/push/sync while keeping each remote isolated under refs/workbook/remotes/<remote>/tasks/* and preserving the origin default for simple teams.

---

**Related finding from PR #71 (2026-08-10):** the perf harness helper deleteTrackingTaskRefs (internal/perf/scenarios.go) clears all of refs/workbook/remotes/ while the product fetch prunes only refs/workbook/remotes/origin/tasks/. Harmless while origin is the only remote (fixtures populate only the narrow prefix), but PR #71 proved this helper is load-bearing for the local-bare sync scenarios, so when multiple remotes land the two scopes must be reconciled deliberately — otherwise samples silently measure a different starting topology per remote. Align the helper scope with whatever per-remote prune semantics this story defines, or document why the harness intentionally clears wider.
